items.stem: A team keeps copying client names into every task so reports are always out of date when a client is renamed. What is the better design?

options.text: Store clients once in a Clients database and relate tasks to it, so a rename updates everywhere
options.rationale: Correct: a relation to a single source avoids duplicated data and keeps everything consistent.

options.text: Add a reminder to update every copy by hand
options.rationale: Manual updates are exactly the error-prone process to eliminate.

options.text: Put client names only in page titles
options.rationale: Titles are still copies and do not stay in sync.

options.text: Create a separate workspace per client
options.rationale: That fragments data and prevents cross-client reporting.

items.explanation: Correct: a relation to a single source avoids duplicated data and keeps everything consistent.

items.stem: Which TWO features let one task database serve different roles without duplicating the data? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Filtered views that show each role only its relevant tasks
options.rationale: Correct: multiple views filter the same underlying data per audience.

options.text: Grouping and sorting a view by status or owner
options.rationale: Correct: grouping and sorting reshape the same data for different needs.

options.text: Exporting a new copy for each person
options.rationale: Copies diverge and defeat a single source of truth.
Icons are decorative and do not reshape data for roles.

items.explanation: Correct: multiple views filter the same underlying data per audience.

items.stem: An agency shares a project page with a client but is surprised the client can see internal sub-pages. What is the likely cause?

options.text: Sub-pages inherited the shared page's access, so permissions must be checked at the level that should be private
options.rationale: Correct: nested pages can inherit sharing, so access must be reviewed where privacy is required.
Exposure follows the sharing model, not randomness.

options.text: Clients can always see everything in a workspace
options.rationale: Access is controlled; the issue is inherited sharing, not blanket visibility.
Sub-page access can be set; inheritance just needs checking.

items.explanation: Correct: nested pages can inherit sharing, so access must be reviewed where privacy is required.
